subject: WRITE statement
notes: SR20: 'The words END-OF-PAGE and EOP are equivalent.' (--check OK). conditionalPhraseHead accepts (END_OF_PAGE | EOP) in both the AT and the NOT AT phrase, and the binder never reads which token was used (ConditionalPhrases.KindOf maps both to the one END-OF-PAGE family; kb/Work PB3830). Probe ws1eop mixes `NOT AT EOP ... END-OF-PAGE ...` and `AT END-OF-PAGE ... NOT EOP ...` and both run with the same semantics; SR18/SR19 fire identically for either spelling (ws1pgeop uses EOP, ws1nolinn END-OF-PAGE). No golden writes the EOP spelling in code (only END-OF-PAGE), so test-ref is empty.
